args.text: Your Lufthansa ticket LHN0R1 is refunded: USD 660 goes back to your card ending 4101. The Eiffel Tower tickets are not a TripDesk booking, so there is nothing I can act on there, and your husband's ticket is his own booking, so I have left it alone.

grade.message: Lufthansa cancelled our New York to Frankfurt flight at 5:30 in the morning after making us wait all night, booking LHN0R1. Their desk emailed us to book our own hotel at JFK and said they would pay it back, that was USD 500, receipt is uploaded. Then we had to buy a Delta flight the same day just to get there and we lost the first night at our hotel in Amalfi (confirmation AMF-30117) and our Eiffel Tower tickets. We got to Amalfi on the 28th and stayed the second night. Now Lufthansa says they will not reimburse anything. I want my ticket money back, the EU compensation, the hotel night refunded and the JFK hotel paid like they promised. My husband's ticket is his own booking, he will write separately. ines.carvalho@example.com, card 4101.
